session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Broad Bear Channel'. An expanding triangle top and lower high major trend reversal start a grinding broad bear channel where stop order bulls keep getting stopped out; a minor wedge at the 10:15 low 4539 and a lower high double top at 4549 fail to reverse far, and the market closes near 4536.
